title: Stage 0 — Chapter 33 Focused GM Assist Rulings
eyebrow: Temple of Elemental Evil / Chapter 33 / staged consistency
lede: Four new or materially reframed findings need rulings. Three repeated findings retain prior GM rulings supported by the transcript.
footer: Applied without asking: 0 corrections. Prior rulings retained: Barkinar formerly led Earth, the recovered shield is +1, and some black-cloaked attackers were undead. Existing earlier Stage 0 review files were left untouched.
